en.title: Scales of the Far North and the Ice Crystal Throne
en.premise: In a frozen world where all of humanity depends solely on geothermal energy to survive, the absolute rule of the 'Ice Castle' has begun to falter. Amidst this instability, a 'secret map' emerges, revealing the location of lost heat sources. Ambitious souls craving wealth and power, a knight praying for the restoration of their homeland, and a scholar in pursuit of the truth—as their conflicting desires intertwine, a blood-soaked struggle for supremacy begins across the frozen wasteland.

zh.title: 極北的天秤與冰晶的王座
zh.premise: 這是一個全人類僅依賴地熱源生存的極寒世界。當掌控絕對權力的『冰之城』之統治開始動搖之時，一張揭示失落熱源所在地的『秘密地圖』現世。追求財富與權力的野心家，渴望祖國復興的騎士，以及追尋真理的學者。隨著各自的意圖交織在一起，一場血染的霸權爭奪戰在凍結的大地上拉開序幕。
